pages.text: --- Page 1 --- Prabodh M, Sangma --- Page 5 --- KU·CHOLSAN HILLS.
PRABODH M.
SANGMA --- Page 6 --- Published by Smt.
Marvina R.
Marak, Hawakhana Deficit Secondary School P.
Araimile West Garo Hills, ( MEGHALAYA ) First Edition 2004 Copy right reserved Dam Gong 50/- Printed at Panthi Ofset Printers, Sukbir Bhawan, Tura.

--- Page 7 --- AGANCHENGANI A.chikrang badita chasong A-song Chigako dongna nangachim aro A.chikrangni jat chigni changiparangoni badiagipa jat da.o songdongenggipa A.chik songo songdongechengachim ba napechengachim uni gimin darangba kakket dake aganna ba mesokna manj.a.
Indiba Achikrangni songdongachabaaniko ma-gitcham pagitchamrangni ku-riting aro daororo Achikrangni songdong achabaaniko niede, A.chikrang ong-achim ine nikna man-a.
A.chikrangni indake janggitangbaanio chanchie aro so.sojengjeng dake janggitangbaani bano maidake bon.chota uarangko am-aonian ia novel da.o nikenggipa bimangona sokaha.
Novelo parakgipa pilak ‘character'- rangan chanchichipe banaigipasan ong-a.
Badita chasong Zaminderrang A.chikrangko rokomari dake sinjetbaengachim aro ua sinjetanirang bano maidake bon-aha iarangko ia novelo chanchichipe seanisam ong-aia.

A.chikrang gipinni nokkol itani aro chonik- onchepe jakkalani ka-ako (bitterness) ka.tongo dingchike rae Zaminderrang baksa dakgrikna ka.kim chabamitingo ‘East India comapny' -ba on-tisa rengsi man.paeaha.
Britishrang sokbakujaode A-chikrangni katong wa.al chaani, Zaminderrangni kosako ka.kim chae jingjengatani bilongbegenchim.
Indiba Britishrang --- Page 8 --- "GARO AFFAIRS".
o jak on.ani gimin aro A.chikrangko ka.sae jakkalani gimin Britishrangna A.chikrang bamaha, indakesa A-chikrang maidakgipa jatchim uko Zaminderrangna chugimik mesokna chol man.jaha.
A.chikrangni kengija bamgija a-kawe jolrangchi reange sko sotarangko aro dakgrik dinggrikna ka.dongarangko Mughalrangba ma-siangachim.
Haida Karaibari Zamindar baksa nanggrikanian A.chikrangni bon.kamgipa Zamindarrang baksa dal.e nanggrikani ong-akon ine chanchiman.a.
Anga dingtangmancha angni skigipa Prof.
Milton S.
Sangmako mittelna namnikbea, maina ua an-tangni sea- jotanisango choljokjeoba, jakchakjaoba aro mikron operation ka-e saae dongoba angni ia novelko jechakgijaan niataiaha.
Uni gimin anga uko dingtangmancha mittelaniko on-chengna namnikbea.
Poraisogiparang ia novelko porae namniksoode, angni neng.anirang indin ong-ramaijaha ine anga kusi ong.begen.
Poraisogipa sakantina angni mittelanichi "Author" --- Page 9 --- AGANSAMSOANI Jeo nangni gisik, unon nangni gam ong-a.
Na.a mainaba gisik nangchongmotode aro uko gisik nange dakode, uan nang-ni aro jatni gam ong-a.
Na-a ki.tap sena gisik nangani dongode aro gisik nangen seode, uan nangni aro jatni gam ong-a.
"KU.CHOLSAN"' ine done Prabodh M.
Sangma, ong.chongmotanggipa itihaso pangchake ia novelko seaha, ua Songsarni golpo gita ong.oba, ong.bebegipa obostao ga.chate seaha.

Iako segipa A.chikrangni itihaskoba tala ine ia seaoniko ma.sina man.a, maina Britishni chasongona kingking batanggipa chasongrango A.chikrangni itihas, Zamindarrang baksa kajia- golmal ong.an gapaiachim.

Aro ian ong.a je, A.chikrang Karaibari Zamindarni onai ka-ako chakna man.jae 1815 bilsini January 9 tariko Karaibarini Zamindar Mahendra Narayan Choudharyni Rajbari ba nokko ritchani ritcha A.chikrang re-ange so.aha aro Mahendra Narayanni depante sa.chonko man.gope gimik sak sni manderangni skorangko sote rae a.brirangchi katangaha.
Ia ong.a obostako Bengal Judicial Criminal, 1815, February 7 tarikni File No.
17- o, janapaha.
Uni gimin ia Novel historical Novel ong.a ine aganna man.gen.
Ia ong.chongmotgipa obostao pangchake, gipin gipin Novelo janapgipa manderangni bimingrangko an-tangan done, --- Page 10 --- golpoko banaiatjole ia Novelko seaha.
Ian nambegipa Novel ba jatni Songsarni golpo ong-aha ine anga nika.
Angni ka.dongani gita, iako porae, Novelni su-uanikosanmangmang poraigiparang cha.tote nikjawa indiba A.chikrangni itihas aro A.chik jatni gitcham bewalrangkoba ia Noveloniko nikatna man-gen.
Nangrimgrike dongani namgnikoba iano nikna man-gen.
Ian authorni gam donanggipa jatni gam ong-a.
Dated Tura, Prof.
Milton S.
Sangma the 29th May, 2004 (Rtd) Pro- Vice Chancellor Tura.
